simple.summary: יְהוֹשֶׁבַע (Yᵉhôwshebaʻ) means Jehosheba , an Israelitess First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 11 2.

definitions.full: H3089. Yehosheba יְהוֺשַׁבְעַת יְהוֺשֶׁ֫בַע, proper name, feminine ( ׳י is an oath ; compare אֱלִישֶׁבַע ) — daughter of Joram of Judah, & wife of Jehoiada the priest; יְהוֺשֶׁבַע 2Kin 11:2 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωσαβεε , Ἰωσαβεθ ); = יְהוֺשַׁבְעַת 2Chr 22:11 (twice in verse) ( ᵐ5 Ἰωσαβεε ). יְהוֺשַׁבְעַת see foregoing.
